column1: # AUTO-EXPANDED from boss_region_worksheet.tsv by tools/build_boss_region_worksheet.py --expand.
# ⭐ HAND ROWS ARE PRESERVED -- this emit UNIONS with what is already here, so a
#   ruling for a boss the worksheet does not cover can be added by hand and will
#   survive every re-emit. The worksheet only carries bosses that own AMBIGUOUS
#   CHECKS; a sweep trigger with none has no row there and would otherwise have
#   nowhere for a human to write down where it is fought.
# WHERE THE BOSS IS FOUGHT, as ruled by a human in the arena_region column.
# gen_data fills SWEEP_ARENA_REGION from this ONLY where PlayRegionParam has no
#   boss-area row -- ranked BELOW measured evidence, so a ruling can replace an
#   ABSENT and never a measurement.
# `ruled_as` is the in-game PLACE name as written; `region` is it mapped through
#   PLACE_TO_REGION. Both are kept so a reader can audit the mapping.
# Unlike boss_verdict_tiles.tsv this KEEPS confirmations: a ruling that agrees
#   with derived_region still answers where the boss stands.
# ⭐ HAND ROWS ADDED 2026-08-26 (#1066, J's Discord report). Both bosses were already
#   ruled in boss_verdict_tiles.tsv by Alaric in-game on 2026-08-10; neither has a
#   PlayRegionParam boss-area row, so nothing carried the ruling into the sweep tables and
#   both hosted GRAVESITE divvy slices while being fought on ground Gravesite does not own:
#     2046400800 Demi-Human Queen Marigga -- boss_verdict_tiles m61_44_41/m61_47_40:
#       "Demi-Human Queen Marigga is on the CERULEAN COAST, not Gravesite."  PlayArea scan
#       corroborates: her tile m61_46_40 buckets 68300/68400 = Cerulean; Gravesite owns neither.
#     2049410800 Jagged Peak Drake -- boss_verdict_tiles m61_48_41/m61_49_42: "the Jagged Peak
#       Drake is on the JAGGED PEAK. Members ship as Gravesite."  Scan: nearest scanned tile
#       m61_49_38 resolves 68410 = Jagged Peak; Gravesite owns 68410 no more than 68500.
#   Since #1066 these rulings also decide the sweep HOST region, so each boss now hosts its own
#   arena's divvy and its Gravesite-measured members go back to Gravesite's own hosts.
